question: How is the constant washing of the mouth characterized in relation to Brahman?
premises: The washing of the mouth is to be done always.
It is described as having gone upward to Brahman.
The statement is addressed to the beloved.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is characterized as reaching upward to Brahman.
uncertainties: The ritual or symbolic meaning of mukha-prakṣālana in this context is uncertain.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is that which has gone upward to Brahman.
